result: Wrote `index.md` for the Vienna expedition. The synthesis pulls out three cross-cutting threads the children couldn't see on their own — (1) the Michelin restaurants' weekend-closure pattern dictates *which night* the dinner falls, which (2) cascades into late-museum and Staatsoper choices for the other evening, with (3) Wiener Festwochen and RubyConf Austria 29–31 May as late-May overlays. Flagged one honest gap: the parent topic specified day-trips within ~30 km, but the activities child only researched Bratislava (~65 km) and Wachau (~80 km) — Klosterneuburg, Wienerwald, Baden bei Wien, Schloss Hof were not covered. Illustrator returned `wrote cover.svg`, included in frontmatter.
